claims.value: 32B instruction-tuned vision-language model from the Qwen family.
claims.evidence: This repo contains the instruction-tuned 32B Qwen2.5-VL model.
Qwen2.5-VL can comprehend videos of over 1 hour
proficient in recognizing common objects such as flowers, birds, fish, and insects, but it is highly capable of analyzing texts, charts, icons, graphics, and layouts within images
The default range for the number of visual tokens per image in the model is 4-16384.
It can's support structured outputs of their contents, benefiting usages in finance, commerce, etc.

claims.value: Vision encoder uses SwiGLU and RMSNorm aligned with the Qwen2.5 LLM structure
claims.evidence: The ViT architecture is further optimized with SwiGLU and RMSNorm, aligning it with the structure of the Qwen2.5 LLM
directly plays as a visual agent that can reason and dynamically direct tools
We extend dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension by adopting dynamic FPS sampling, enabling the model to comprehend videos at various sampling rates

claims.value: Flash Attention 2 is recommended for acceleration and memory savings in multi-image and video scenarios.
claims.evidence: We recommend enabling flash_attention_2 for better acceleration and memory saving, especially in multi-image and video scenarios
